acceptance: The app opens from local files without fetching remote resources.
A nonblank answer and explicit confidence are required before reveal.
Reveal records an immutable answer and confidence snapshot; self-checks remain user-reported.
JSON export preserves references, answers, confidence, self-checks, notes, rounds, and reveal times.
Desktop, narrow mobile, keyboard, empty, malformed-input, and storage-failure paths are exercised.
Tests and demo run deterministically without network or child processes.
